name: Validate Provider Extraction
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Validates extracted provider JSON entries against the provider schema, including required identity/status fields plus optional search and location field types

inputs.name: provider_extraction_json
inputs.label: Provider Extraction JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of provider search plan objects to validate, each with name, status, review_needed, geographic_search, etc.

outputs.name: invalid_json
outputs.label: Invalid JSON
outputs.description: True if the input failed validation, false if it passed
